knowledge.title: Knowledge
knowledge.description: Collect private literature, turn evidence into reviewed knowledge, and carry it into Research Tasks without losing provenance or access control.
knowledge.searchPlaceholder: Search titles, abstracts, notes, and PDF text
knowledge.noPapers: No papers in this space yet.
knowledge.noItems: No Knowledge has been captured in this space yet.
knowledge.privateHint: Paper files remain inside their Personal, Lab, or Project scope. Physical deduplication never grants access.
knowledge.pdfRequirements: Valid PDF only, up to the instance limit. Text is extracted locally for search.
knowledge.exactDoi: This DOI already has a canonical Paper. Confirming will add it to this space without sharing another space's files or notes.
knowledge.candidateConflict: A similar no-DOI Paper is already visible to you. Select it or explicitly confirm that this is a distinct work.
knowledge.notesPlaceholder: Why this paper matters, limitations, or reading notes
knowledge.tagsPlaceholder: Type a tag and press Enter
knowledge.airaSuggestedHint: Aira used only this Paper's authorized metadata, notes, and available extracted text. Edit the candidate freely, then confirm creation; it remains Suggested until human review.
knowledge.airaPersonalDraftHint: Aira used only this Paper's authorized metadata, notes, and available extracted text. Edit the candidate freely, then confirm it as your personal Draft; Aira assistance remains recorded in provenance.
knowledge.airaProcessingNotice: Draft with Aira sends the authorized source excerpts shown by this scope to the instance's configured AI provider. The original Paper and PDF permissions do not change.
knowledge.restrictedAiraConfirm: This sends authorized content from the Restricted Paper or attached file to the configured AI provider for this instance, including bounded extracted text. Confirm that this use is permitted by the applicable research data policy. No visibility or file permission will be changed.
knowledge.protocolDraftImpact: Aira will use this exact Knowledge revision to generate an editable draft. The Protocol is written to the target Project only after you preview and confirm it in the editor, with immutable provenance recorded.
knowledge.knowledgeBodyPlaceholder: State the reusable claim, method, decision, or finding and preserve uncertainty.
knowledge.reviewHint: Reviewed means this Project or Lab has assessed and adopted the current revision; it does not mean universal scientific truth.
knowledge.evidenceProvenanceHint: These immutable snapshots show the exact Record or DataAsset Evidence used to create this candidate. Review them before adoption.
knowledge.publishImpact: A new scoped Knowledge asset will be created with lineage. Paper metadata is copied; private files are not.
knowledge.filesOmitted: {count} private file(s) will remain in the source scope.
knowledge.published: Knowledge published as a new draft
knowledge.providerUnavailable: External literature search is optional. Manual and file imports remain available.
knowledge.fileOpenError: The protected file could not be opened.

research.title: Research
research.description: Define the question and success criteria once. Aira and your team can then plan, execute, hand off experiments, validate evidence, and return an auditable result.
research.noNotifications: No Research attention item is waiting for you.
research.emailDeliveryFailedHint: The email reminder could not be delivered after automatic retries. The authoritative work item remains available in Platform.
research.airaTaskBrief: Turn a research question into a Task brief
research.airaTaskBriefHint: Aira can propose an editable goal, success and stop criteria, and the smallest useful set of capabilities currently available to you. Nothing is created or started here.
research.airaQuestionPlaceholder: Describe the scientific question, desired result, and important context in your own words.
research.airaConstraintsPlaceholder: Optional constraints: samples, safety, time, reproducibility, excluded methods, or other boundaries.
research.airaTaskDraftReady: Aira prepared an editable Research Task draft
research.taskNamePlaceholder: For example: Optimize the cell transfection condition
research.goalPlaceholder: State the scientific question and the result you need.
research.criteriaPlaceholder: One objectively checkable criterion per line
research.stopPlaceholder: One budget, safety, time, or evidence boundary per line
research.researchPolicyHint: Automatic execution requires three independent gates: this versioned Lab policy, an eligible Executor Binding, and an unexpired evaluated grant for the exact Capability version and executor. Assisted mode always asks, and physical or external commitments remain approval-gated.
research.autonomyBoundedPolicyHint: Automatically execute only the low-risk categories enabled below; all other Actions ask.
research.autonomyFullPolicyHint: Operate independently only inside these exact boundaries; a denial or missing condition still stops execution.
research.autoReadOnlyToolsHint: Also requires a version-pinned Executor Binding and an unexpired evaluated grant for this exact Tool version and executor.
research.autoWaitEventsHint: May open a typed wait without contacting a person or external system.
research.autoIsolatedComputeHint: Requires a pinned Compute Environment with no network and costs within the limits below.
research.automaticComputeLimitsHint: These are per-Action ceilings. The Task budget and deadline remain additional hard boundaries.
research.isolatedComputeBoundary: Only low-risk, network-disabled Compute can qualify. Missing price, a different currency, or any exceeded ceiling requires approval.
research.researchPolicyReasonPlaceholder: Explain why these automatic-execution boundaries are appropriate for the Lab.
research.researchPolicyFutureRunsOnly: Confirmation creates an immutable revision for future Research Environments. Existing Runs keep their captured policy.
research.evaluatedAutonomyGrantsHint: Grant automatic execution only after repeated supervised success on the exact versioned capability and executor boundary.
research.autonomyGrantBoundary: A policy switch alone never authorizes automatic execution. Platform requires at least five recent supervised successes and no failure; any version, executor, level, or expiry mismatch returns the Action to human confirmation.
research.noAutonomyEvaluationHistory: No eligible supervised history yet. Complete this exact digital Action with human confirmation at least five times to make it eligible for a grant.
research.configureAutonomyGrantHint: This does not bypass the Lab policy, Executor Binding, budget, deadline, or input validation. It admits only the exact evaluated target shown below.
research.revokeAutonomyGrantHint: Revocation excludes this grant from newly captured Research Environments. Existing Runs preserve their immutable environment; expiry still fails closed at execution time.
research.autonomyGrantReasonPlaceholder: Explain why the supervised evidence justifies this time-bounded automatic execution grant.
research.autonomyGrantFutureRunsOnly: Confirmation changes future Research Environments only. Existing environment snapshots are not silently rewritten, and grant expiry is still checked when an Action runs.
research.methodsPlaceholder: Select one or more versioned methods
research.methodsHint: Selected Protocol versions are pinned when the Task is created. You can also add a human Protocol Action later.
research.digitalCapabilitiesPlaceholder: Select the tools Aira may propose
research.digitalCapabilitiesHint: Only selected, version-pinned tools become part of this Research Environment. Every Aira-proposed tool execution still follows its approval policy.
research.noDigitalCapabilities: No digital capability is pinned. This Task remains usable through Protocol and explicit wait Actions.
research.executorBindingsHint: Lab Executor Bindings govern how future work resolves people, Platform workers, instrument gateways, and external service providers. Existing Actions keep their captured execution boundary.
research.noExecutorBindings: No Lab override is configured. Platform uses the visible, approval-gated default binding for each selected capability.
research.selectCapability: Select a human, digital, instrument, or service capability
research.bindingConstraintsHint: Leaving a field empty allows every value. Constraints are enforced when a future Task captures this binding.
research.changeReasonPlaceholder: Why is this execution policy needed?
research.bindingFutureRunsOnly: This revision affects future Research Environments or dynamic Action previews. Captured environments and confirmed Actions do not change.
research.selectHumanExecutor: Select the Task owner, a member, or verified skill matching
research.humanExecutorHint: A specific person must have Project execution access. Skill matching considers only verified, unexpired skills, current availability, and capacity. Eligibility is checked again before assignment.
research.humanExecutorProfilesHint: Record governed availability, workload capacity, and skill claims for Lab members. A skill only participates in automatic matching after a Lab manager verifies it.
research.noHumanExecutorProfiles: No human executor profile has been configured.
research.executorSkillsHint: Use a stable lowercase key. Level ranges from 1 to 5; verification and expiry are enforced during matching.
research.noExecutorSkills: No skill claim is recorded. This person can still be assigned directly.
research.executorProfileConfirmationHint: Confirmation creates an audited profile revision. Existing Research Environments do not change; future skill matching and dispatch revalidation use the new state.
research.noVerifiedExecutorSkills: No current verified skill is available. Configure and verify a human executor profile before creating this binding.
research.invalidBindingConstraints: Constraints must be a valid JSON object.
research.knowledgePlaceholder: Select reviewed Project or Lab Knowledge
research.knowledgeHint: Selected revisions are copied into the Research Environment. Restricted Knowledge must first be published as a scoped derivative.
research.noBudgetLimit: No budget limit is configured for this Task.
research.budgetEntryHint: Budget entries are immutable. Preview the projected totals before confirming a reservation, release, expense, or credit.
research.budgetModelCostHint: Provider-reported model charges are recorded automatically when their currency matches this Task. Missing or different-currency charges remain in usage metering and must be recorded manually; Platform never invents an exchange rate.
research.budgetLoadError: Budget ledger could not be loaded. Totals are hidden to avoid showing stale values.
research.operationalLimitAmendmentHint: Replace the complete deadline and budget boundary through preview and confirmation. The prior values and reason remain in an immutable audit event.
research.budgetCurrencyLocked: This budget already has ledger entries. You may change its ceiling, but cannot remove it or change its currency.
research.budgetAmendmentInvalid: Use a positive ceiling above the committed total. A budget with ledger entries must keep its currency and cannot be removed.
research.amendmentReasonPlaceholder: Explain why the approved operating boundary is changing
research.resumeAfterAmendment: The new limits permit continuation, but the paused Run remains stopped. Review its state and choose Resume explicitly.
research.resourceRequirementsPlaceholder: Select the inventory or equipment types this Task may use
research.resourceRequirementsHint: The current resource-type revision is pinned. A concrete container or equipment time is selected, checked, and confirmed later as a Resource Action.
research.noResourceRequirements: No operational resource requirement is pinned.
research.externalServicesPlaceholder: Select approved services for this Research Environment
research.externalServicesHint: The current service contract revision is copied into the Research Environment. Selecting it does not place an order or spend funds.
research.noExternalServices: No external research service is pinned.
research.computeEnvironmentsPlaceholder: Select governed runtimes for this Research Environment
research.computeEnvironmentsHint: The exact immutable environment revision is pinned. This does not run code or allocate compute resources.
research.computePinnedOnlyHint: This is a pinned execution contract only. Code execution remains unavailable until an independently operated Compute Runner is connected.
research.serviceRequestHint: Create a version-pinned Service Job. A quote and explicit order approval are required before Platform reserves funds or samples leave the Lab.
research.serviceSchemaHint: Platform validates this object against the pinned service input Schema.
research.serviceRequestPreviewHint: Review the exact provider, contract revision, request, and effects. Confirming this step does not approve an order.
research.serviceResultSchemaHint: Platform validates this object against the pinned result Schema.
research.serviceOperationPreviewHint: Confirm this immutable state transition and its exact payload.

serviceOperationHint.quote: The quote is immutable after confirmation and creates a separate order approval. Budget is reserved only when that approval is granted.
serviceOperationHint.progress: Record the provider's actual state. Marking a job failed releases the reserved quote and returns control to the Research Run.
serviceOperationHint.custody: Record who transferred which governed Lab resource, when, and where. This audit event does not change inventory quantity.
serviceOperationHint.result: Validate the result, link exact DataAsset versions, settle actual cost, and return typed evidence to the Research Run.

research.resourceReservationHint: Only resource types pinned in this Research Environment are available. Platform checks the exact resource revision, permissions, inventory, and booking conflicts before confirmation.
research.resourcePreviewHint: Review the exact resource revision, quantity or time window, and effects before reserving it.
research.releaseReservationHint: Releasing inventory restores its available quantity. Cancelling equipment frees its booked time. The historical Research Action remains in the audit trail.
research.aiOffHint: AI is currently unavailable. You can still create the Task, schedule Protocol work, submit Records, and review the result through deterministic controls.
research.effectCreate: Create a versioned Research Task and its first draft Run.
research.effectPin: Capture the current Lab, Project, permissions, and selected Protocol versions in a Research Environment.
research.effectAi: After you start it, Aira can choose pinned Protocols, allowlisted digital tools, or explicit external waits until it reaches an approval or review boundary.
research.effectManual: Execution remains available through explicit human Protocol Actions without AI.
research.warningManual: AI is unavailable on this deployment. The deterministic Research workbench remains fully usable.
research.warningNoCapability: No executable capability is selected for Aira. Add a Protocol or digital capability, or continue with explicit manual Actions.
research.previewAiPath: Aira can plan this Task with pinned Protocols and governed digital Research Actions.
research.previewManualPath: This Task will use the normal deterministic workbench until an AI path is available.
research.noMethods: No Protocol has been pinned. Aira may still use approved digital tools or request an explicit external result.
research.noKnowledge: No reviewed Knowledge has been pinned yet.
research.loadError: Research work could not be loaded
research.noTasks: No Research Tasks yet. Define a goal to start the first auditable run.
research.noWorkItems: Nothing is waiting for you right now.
research.noApprovals: No Research Action is waiting for your approval.
research.cancelConfirm: This stops the active Run and cancels unfinished Actions. Existing Records and provenance remain available.
research.humanWorkBoundary: Use Human Work for observation, collection, coordination, or review that is not a scientific method execution. Use a Protocol when the work defines how an experiment is performed.
research.humanWorkInstructionsPlaceholder: State exactly what the assignee must do and what must not be assumed.
research.submissionFieldsHint: Define only the bounded values Platform must validate. Do not ask for a free-form report when a typed field is possible.
research.fieldKeyInvalid: Use 1–64 lowercase letters, numbers, or underscores, starting with a letter.
research.fieldKeyDuplicate: Each field key must be unique.
research.choiceOptionsInvalid: Provide at least two different options.
research.dataAssetRangeInvalid: The maximum cannot be less than the minimum.
research.humanWorkPreviewHint: Confirm the destination, assignee, and exact submission contract. The result still requires authorized review before it becomes validated Evidence.
research.waitingForHumanReview: The submission is immutable while it waits for the Task owner or an authorized Research approver.
research.humanWorkAccepted: Human Work accepted and registered as validated Evidence
research.humanWorkGovernanceHint: Platform validates this fixed contract, keeps exact DataAsset versions, records reviewer identity, and releases downstream Actions only after acceptance. Aira cannot accept its own proposed work.
research.invalidHumanWorkContract: This Human Work contract is missing or unsupported. No unvalidated free-form submission is allowed.
research.toolActionHint: Choose an allowlisted, read-only tool. Platform validates its contract, pins its version, and records its output without silently turning candidates into formal research assets.
research.instrumentActionHint: Choose a Lab-allowlisted command and an approved equipment booking. The on-premises Gateway pulls the job; Platform never sends an arbitrary device instruction.
research.noInstrumentCommands: No compatible instrument command is available. Pin the equipment type to this Task and ask a Lab manager to configure its Gateway allowlist.
research.instrumentBookingHint: Only your approved, unexpired bookings are eligible; another person's equipment time cannot be dispatched by proxy.
research.instrumentSchemaHint: Platform validates this object against the command's pinned input Schema.
research.instrumentNoAutomaticRetry: Physical operations are never retried automatically. A failure or lost heartbeat pauses the Run for human inspection.
research.instrumentStopHint: A queued job is cancelled immediately. A delivered or running job stops only after the on-premises Gateway receives and acknowledges this request.
research.instrumentStopConfirm: Review the impact before sending the stop request. The Research Task will pause for equipment inspection.
research.instrumentStopImpactPause: Pause the Research Task for safety review.
research.instrumentStopImpactAcknowledge: Cancel queued work immediately, or wait for the on-premises Gateway to acknowledge a delivered job.
research.computeActionHint: Submit reviewed Python or R source to a pinned Compute Environment. An authorized Runner executes it in isolation only after approval; the Platform API never evaluates the source.
research.computeNoReadyRunner: No authorized Runner is currently ready. You may prepare and approve this job, but it will remain queued until a compatible Runner is healthy.
research.computeSourcePlaceholder: Enter deterministic Python or R source for the isolated Runner.
research.computeInputSchemaHint: Platform validates this object against the pinned environment contract.
research.computeInputAssetsHint: Only the selected immutable versions are exposed to this job. Every download is authorized and audited.
research.computeOutputFilesHint: Write each file to /airalogy/output/files/<output filename>. Only declared files can leave the isolated workspace; successful jobs register checksum-verified files as editable draft DataAssets.
research.computeOutputDraftHint: Registered as a draft DataAsset for review.
research.computePreviewHint: Review the exact environment revision, source digest, inputs, limits, cost ceiling, and Runner availability before requesting approval.
research.computeRequestCreated: Compute Job created and sent for approval
research.computeCancelHint: A job awaiting approval or still queued is cancelled immediately. A delivered or running job stops only after its Runner acknowledges the request.
research.computeCancelPreviewHint: Review the exact effects before cancelling this computation. Partial output is not accepted as a completed result.
research.noToolsAvailable: No digital research tool is available on this deployment.
research.searchQueryPlaceholder: What should this tool look for?
research.waitEventHint: Use an explicit wait boundary when a person, instrument, or external service must deliver something before the Run can continue.
research.waitTitlePlaceholder: For example: wait for sequencing results
research.digitalActionPreviewHint: Confirm the exact tool or event contract, destination, and effect before changing the Run.
research.toolResultsStayDraft: Search output remains traceable Action output. It is not automatically accepted as Knowledge or Evidence.
research.waitPausesRun: This creates one typed external boundary. The Run resumes only after a valid result is previewed and confirmed.
research.signalResponsibility: Confirm that this payload came from the expected source. Platform validates the pinned contract and records who supplied it.
research.signalPreviewHint: Review the exact payload before it completes the waiting Action and resumes the Run.
research.invalidEventPayload: The event payload must be a valid JSON object
research.signalReceived: External result received; the Run can continue
research.reviewRequiredHint: Aira has produced a candidate result package. A person must assess the goal, scientific outcome, and conclusion before this Task is complete.
research.runInheritanceHint: A new Run preserves all prior evidence and inherits the source Run's exact Research Environment. It does not silently switch Protocol, Knowledge, Tool, or policy versions.
research.runPurposePlaceholder: Explain why this Run is needed and what should be retried, reproduced, or continued.
research.runPreviewWarning: Confirm this lineage and fixed environment before reopening the Task for another execution.
research.runEffectCreate: Create a new draft Run under this Research Task.
research.runEffectInherit: Clone the exact source Research Environment and record its digest.
research.runEffectPreserve: Preserve every earlier Run, Action, Record, Evidence, Claim, and result package.
research.runEffectReopen: Clear only the Task's current-result summary and reopen it for a new execution and review.
research.noRunConclusion: No conclusion was recorded for this Run.
research.approveHint: Approval activates this exact, digest-bound Action. Depending on its type, Platform will assign Protocol work, queue a tool, or open an external wait. Changed Actions require a new approval.
research.rejectHint: Rejecting cancels this Action. Aira will replan from the recorded reason when AI is available; otherwise the Task returns to manual control.
research.rejectionPlaceholder: Explain why this Action should not execute and what should change.
research.approvedFromWorkbench: Approved from the Research Task workbench
research.noActions: No Action has been scheduled yet.
research.resultPackageLoadError: The result package could not be loaded.
research.resultPackageDownloadError: The result package could not be downloaded.
research.resultPackageSealed: This exact package was finalized by a person and sealed as an immutable Run snapshot.
research.resultPackageUnsealed: This is a compatible legacy package. It can be inspected and exported, but no immutable finalization snapshot exists.
research.noConclusion: No conclusion has been produced yet.
research.initialValuesHint: Optional. Values are passed to the Record form as a draft and remain editable.
research.invalidInitialValues: Initial values must be a valid JSON object
research.actionPreviewHint: Confirm the pinned Protocol version, destination, and assignee before creating this Action.
research.reviewResponsibility: Completion is a scientific judgment. Review the evidence and preserve uncertainty; do not approve only because the automation finished.
research.independentReviewerHint: A separate model critiques the fixed result context. Its recommendation is advisory and cannot complete the Task.
research.reproductionAssessmentHint: Compare the sealed result of Run #{source} with validated Evidence produced by replication Run #{replication}.
research.criterionRationalePlaceholder: Explain how the Evidence supports this criterion-level judgment.
research.legacyReplicationSource: This source predates immutable result snapshots. Its digest is still pinned, but the final evaluation will retain that legacy limitation.
research.scientificAssetsHint: Keep produced data, evidence quality, scientific claims, uncertainty, and review state traceable outside the conversation.
research.assetsLoadError: Scientific assets could not be loaded
research.noScientificAssets: No formal result assets yet. Records submitted from Research work are registered automatically as Evidence.
research.actionOutputEvidenceHint: The exact structured output of the completed Action will be sealed as an immutable source snapshot. The new Evidence remains pending until a human validates it.
research.claimDraftBoundary: A Claim is an editable scientific interpretation, not a verified fact. Review its exact Evidence, uncertainty, and scope before accepting it.
research.airaClaimInstructionPlaceholder: Optional focus, comparison, or scientific constraint for Aira
research.airaClaimDraftHint: Select only validated Evidence. Aira must assess every selected item, including contradictions, and cannot accept the Claim.
research.airaClaimGenerated: Aira prepared this Suggested Claim with {model}. Edit it as needed, then preview and confirm it before human review.
research.airaClaimDraftReady: Aira Claim draft is ready for review
research.airaClaimContextChanged: The Aira draft was cleared because its Evidence context changed.
research.claimEvidenceRationalePlaceholder: Why this Evidence has this relationship to the Claim
research.validatedEvidence: Validated Record, DataAsset, or Action output Evidence
research.knowledgeSuggestionBoundary: This creates editable Suggested Knowledge, not an accepted scientific fact. A Knowledge reviewer must assess and adopt it separately.
research.protocolImprovementBoundary: This records a version-specific change proposal. It does not modify the published Protocol; an expert must review it before a new version draft can be created.
research.airaImprovementInstructionPlaceholder: Optional focus, constraints, or questions for Aira
research.airaImprovementDraftHint: Select a Protocol and validated Evidence first. Aira only prepares an editable draft; it cannot approve or apply it.
research.airaImprovementGenerated: Aira prepared this draft with {model}. You remain responsible for reviewing and confirming the content.
research.airaImprovementDraftReady: Aira draft is ready for review
research.airaImprovementContextChanged: The Aira draft was cleared because its Protocol or Evidence context changed.
research.protocolImprovementReviewConfirm: Accept only after checking the pinned Protocol version and every Evidence snapshot. The decision is recorded before any Protocol content can change.
research.noProtocolImprovements: No evidence-backed Protocol improvement has been proposed yet.
research.assetPreviewHint: Review the destination and exact content before creating this versioned scientific asset.
research.markReadyConfirm: Mark this DataAsset version as ready for use as research evidence?
research.evidenceReviewConfirm: This decision changes the evidence quality state and will be recorded in the provenance timeline.
research.claimReviewConfirm: Accept only after checking the linked evidence and stated uncertainty. The review decision will be recorded.
research.noClaims: No scientific Claim has been recorded yet.
research.noEvidence: No Evidence has been registered yet.
research.noDataAssets: No DataAsset has been registered yet.
research.noKnowledgeCandidates: No candidate Knowledge has been derived from validated results yet.

event.run_created: New Run created from a prior execution
event.protocol_improvement_applied: Protocol improvement applied as a new version
event.compute_job_leased: Compute Job delivered to a Runner

event.wait_event_created: Run is waiting for an external result

recordDiary.title: Research Log
recordDiary.description: Capture research progress and review authoritative activity from Records, Protocols, Knowledge, and Research Tasks.
recordDiary.logPreviewHint: Review the scope and content before saving this durable research entry.
recordDiary.heatmapHint: View yearly submission activity and click a day to inspect its records
recordDiary.calendarHint: Browse records by month; click a day to filter records and click an event to open its report
recordDiary.calendarTruncated: This calendar range has many records. Showing the first {count}.

recordExport.title: Bulk export Records
recordExport.revisionHistoryHint: By default, only the current revision at snapshot time is exported.
recordExport.includeAttachmentsHint: Bundle files referenced by Records into the .aira archive for offline recovery.

resourceLibrary.title: Lab resource library
resourceLibrary.description: Manage shared materials, samples, equipment, locations, inventory, bookings, lineage, and audit history in one place.
resourceLibrary.externalServicesHint: Register external research providers and immutable service contracts that a Research Task may pin into its environment.
resourceLibrary.serviceGovernanceHint: This catalog describes approved providers and versioned service contracts. It does not place an order, spend funds, or transfer a sample.
resourceLibrary.serviceAccessDeniedHint: Only Lab members with research service management access can maintain this catalog.
resourceLibrary.computeEnvironmentsHint: Register immutable, bounded runtime contracts that Research Tasks can pin before execution infrastructure is connected.
resourceLibrary.computeGovernanceHint: A Compute Environment declares what a separate runner may execute. Platform never executes research code on the API host, and selecting an environment does not start or fund a job.
resourceLibrary.computeAccessDeniedHint: Only Lab members with research compute management access can maintain this catalog.
resourceLibrary.noComputeEnvironments: No Compute Environment has been registered
resourceLibrary.computeImageHint: Use an exact image reference ending in @sha256:<64 lowercase hexadecimal characters>. Mutable tags and local file paths are rejected.
resourceLibrary.computeEgressHint: Enter one hostname or hostname:port per line. URLs, paths, credentials, wildcards, and IP ranges are not accepted.
resourceLibrary.computeEnvironmentImpact: Confirmation creates an immutable environment revision. Existing Research Tasks keep their exact captured revision, and no code is executed.
resourceLibrary.computeRunnersHint: Register isolated execution planes and explicitly bind each one to the exact Compute Environment revisions it may run.
resourceLibrary.computeRunnerSecurityHint: A Runner is eligible for work only after it reports non-root execution, a read-only root filesystem, network isolation, and no host mounts. Its credential never grants access to unbound environment revisions.
resourceLibrary.noComputeRunners: No Compute Runner has been registered
resourceLibrary.computeRunnerCreateImpact: Confirmation creates a Lab-scoped Runner identity and displays its credential once. It cannot run any environment until an exact revision is bound.
resourceLibrary.computeRunnerUpdateImpact: Confirmation creates an audit revision. Disabling the Runner stops future leasing without changing its credential or bindings.
resourceLibrary.computeRunnerRotateImpact: The current credential will stop working immediately. The replacement is shown only once; Runner identity and bindings remain unchanged.
resourceLibrary.runnerEnvironmentsHint: {runner} may execute only the exact revisions listed here.
resourceLibrary.noRunnerEnvironments: This Runner has no authorized environment revisions
resourceLibrary.computeRunnerBindingImpact: Confirmation authorizes only this exact environment revision. Future revisions remain unavailable until separately reviewed and bound.
resourceLibrary.computeRunnerBindingSaved: Compute Environment revision bound to Runner
resourceLibrary.removeRunnerEnvironmentImpact: The Runner will stop receiving new work for this exact revision. Existing definitions and audit history are preserved.
resourceLibrary.noServiceProviders: No external research providers have been registered
resourceLibrary.serviceProviderImpact: Confirming creates or updates a Lab-governed provider record and adds an audit revision. Existing Research Environments do not change.
resourceLibrary.noServiceOfferings: This provider has no registered services
resourceLibrary.serviceOfferingImpact: Confirming creates an immutable service revision. Existing Tasks remain pinned to their original revision.
resourceLibrary.instrumentGatewaysHint: Connect on-premises equipment through a Lab-owned, audited execution boundary.
resourceLibrary.instrumentGatewaySecurityHint: Gateways pull only signed, structured jobs. Aira never receives a device credential or sends an arbitrary equipment command.
resourceLibrary.gatewayAccessDeniedHint: Only Lab Owners and Managers with equipment service access can manage device connections.
resourceLibrary.noInstrumentGateways: No Instrument Gateways have been configured
resourceLibrary.allowedCommandsHint: {gateway} may execute only the versioned equipment commands listed here.
resourceLibrary.noAllowedCommands: No equipment commands are allowed for this gateway
resourceLibrary.gatewayCreateImpact: Confirming creates the gateway and shows its credential once. It cannot execute anything until an allowed command is added.
resourceLibrary.gatewayUpdateImpact: Confirming creates an audit revision. Disabling the gateway prevents it from receiving new work.
resourceLibrary.rotateCredentialImpact: The current credential will stop working immediately. Update the local gateway with the replacement before resuming work.
resourceLibrary.gatewayCredentialOnce: Copy and store this credential securely now. Platform will not display it again.
resourceLibrary.deviceConfirmationRequired: Require confirmation on the physical device before execution
resourceLibrary.safetyContractHint: The locally installed adapter must read and attest these conditions immediately before every device start. Platform does not infer them from AI output.
resourceLibrary.emergencyStopRequired: Require a locally available emergency stop
resourceLibrary.highRiskSafetyRequired: High-risk commands require both operator presence and an emergency stop in addition to device confirmation.
resourceLibrary.commandChangeImpact: Confirming pins these schemas and safety settings as a new allowlist revision. Completed history stays unchanged; queued high-risk jobs always retain the minimum operator and emergency-stop gate.
resourceLibrary.commandToggleImpact: This change applies only to future job dispatch and is recorded in the gateway audit history.
resourceLibrary.scanHint: Use a browser camera scanner or paste the stable QR/barcode value below.
resourceLibrary.recentResourcesHint: Resource records stay linked to the Schema revision that validated them.
resourceLibrary.noResources: No resources match the current filters
resourceLibrary.appendOnlyHint: Inventory operations are immutable audit events; corrections are recorded as new events.
resourceLibrary.locationsHint: Model nested rooms, freezers, shelves, racks, and other physical locations.
resourceLibrary.bookingsHint: Pending and approved bookings cannot overlap for the same equipment.
resourceLibrary.remindersHint: Expiry, calibration, maintenance, booking, and inventory notices appear here.
resourceLibrary.typesHint: Each resource type combines an immutable capability configuration with one resource_definition Protocol version.
resourceLibrary.registerTypeHint: Upload a Protocol with kind=resource_definition, then select one of its published versions to register as a Lab resource type.
resourceLibrary.selectResourceDefinition: Select a published resource-definition Protocol version
resourceLibrary.resourceMigrationSummary: {ready} resource(s) can migrate automatically; {review} require manual review.
resourceLibrary.sampleCapabilityHint: Sample semantics use this Resource type's Schema for discipline fields and the shared Resource ledger for identity, access, containers, quantity, and immutable lineage. Equipment-only capabilities are disabled.
resourceLibrary.importHint: CSV, TSV, and JSON imports run field mapping and Schema dry-run validation before any rows are saved.
resourceLibrary.resourceRevised: A new resource revision was added
resourceLibrary.sampleLineageHint: Sample identity relationships are immutable. Inventory transfers and consumption remain separate audit events.
resourceLibrary.sampleLineageReasonPlaceholder: Explain how this Sample was derived, aliquoted, split, or pooled.
resourceLibrary.sampleLineageImpact: Platform will recheck both Sample revisions, access, and the full lineage graph before appending this relationship. It cannot be edited afterwards.
resourceLibrary.sampleLineagePreview: Confirm the immutable relationship from {parent} to {child}. Inventory quantities will not change.
resourceLibrary.sampleLineageRedacted: The connected Sample and provenance details are Restricted. Ask its custodian for access if needed.

protocolGenerator.title: AI Protocol draft
protocolGenerator.description: Describe the goal, steps, data to capture, and constraints in plain language. Aira will create a Protocol draft you can preview and refine.
protocolGenerator.replaceHint: The new draft replaces the current Protocol content; it is not saved until you confirm.

protocolGenerator.generateFailed: Failed to generate the Protocol draft.

aiCreate.title: Create a Protocol with AI
aiCreate.description: Describe the experiment and let Aira generate the structured workflow and record fields—no AIMD or Python required.
aiCreate.dialogDescription: Name the draft, then describe the experiment in plain language. You can preview it immediately and keep refining it through conversation.
aiCreate.createFailed: Failed to create the AI Protocol.
aiCreate.continueHint: The draft is ready. Continue telling Aira what to change from the left panel.
aiCreate.knowledgeSourceHint: Revision {revision} of “{title}” will guide the draft. Platform validates it again and records provenance when you save.
aiCreate.knowledgeSourceInvalid: The Knowledge revision is invalid. Return to Knowledge and start again.
aiCreate.knowledgeSourceChanged: This Knowledge has a newer revision. Return to Knowledge and preview the flow again.
aiCreate.knowledgeSourceUnavailable: This Knowledge is unavailable, archived, superseded, or no longer accessible.
aiCreate.saveKnowledgeLineage: When you confirm, this Protocol version will be linked to Knowledge revision {revision}. Saving fails closed if the source changed.

protocolImprovement.changed: This proposal changed or is no longer reviewed. Return to the Research Task and reload it.
protocolImprovement.unavailableHint: This proposal is unavailable or no longer accessible. Return to the Research Task and start again.
